name: sghf
description: Agent skill for SGHF: fast linear-Gaussian fits, profile tests, CLs upper limits and vectorized toys on pyhf/HistFactory workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Fast approximate inference on pyhf workspaces
interface.longDescription: Fit HistFactory workspaces, run discovery and exclusion tests, invert CLs curves for upper limits, and generate vectorized pseudo-experiments with SGHF's linear-Gaussian approximation. Includes the approximation's validity boundary and the pyhf cross-checks required before publishing.
